# Caza

> Caza is a free Chrome extension that adds a 0–100 buyer Demand Score, nearby sales comps, rental comps (active asking rents), investor numbers (cap rate, cash flow, DSCR, cash-on-cash) and a PDF comps report to Zillow listings. The extension runs in the browser: no account, no Caza servers, and no background upload of listing data. (This website, usecaza.com, uses Google Analytics.) Free right now. Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by Zillow Group.

Site: https://usecaza.com/ · Install: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/oojoopmelbnbddhjmemdggbkeflhjnpk · Contact: gus@usecaza.com

## What it does on a Zillow listing

- Demand Score (0–100) from the listing's saves, page views and days on market, with price cuts and back-on-market listings flagged; sort a search page by score, saves, views, days on market or price drops.
- Sales comps: runs Zillow's own Recently Sold search around the home, keeps condos, houses, 2–4 unit and 5+ unit buildings apart, stars the closest matches, shows median sold price and price per square foot. Widen radius, add older sales, add or drop a comp.
- Rental comps: similar active rentals nearby matched on bedrooms and property type, typical range and median. Labeled as asking rents, not signed leases.
- Investor numbers: cap rate, monthly cash flow, DSCR, cash-on-cash; price per unit and GRM on multifamily. Taxes and insurance start from state estimates you can edit; every input is tagged Reported, Zillow est., Assumed, Estimate (state avg) or Yours.
- Renter view: all-in monthly cost with required fees, effective rent after free weeks (rent × (lease months − free months) ÷ lease months, 12-month lease assumed unless stated), a rent-cut flag, and how the rent compares with similar rentals nearby ("Higher than 9 of 12 similar 2-bed rentals nearby (asking)"). When the rent is under 60% of the nearby median with at least five comps, a caution says to verify the listing before paying anything and links the FTC's rental-listing-scams article.
- PDF comps report (sales or rental) with the user's name, brokerage and phone; Copy summary for plain text. Not an appraisal.

## Who it is for

Listing agents, buyer's agents, real estate investors and brokers, landlords and property managers, home buyers, and renters. Works on zillow.com in Chrome on desktop, US listings only. Does not work on Redfin or Realtor.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://usecaza.com/): features, who it's for, how it works, where the numbers come from, FAQ.
- [Examples](https://usecaza.com/examples): four example walkthroughs with sample data (not customer stories): a buyer's agent replying to a client's Zillow link, a listing agent printing a comps PDF for a seller meeting, an investor screening a house as a rental, a renter checking all-in cost and a far-below-market caution.
- [Guides index](https://usecaza.com/blog)
- [How to pull comps on Zillow](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-pull-comps-on-zillow): Sold filter, drawn boundary, matching rules, median price per square foot, where Zillow comps go wrong.
- [How to estimate rent with rental comps on Zillow](https://usecaza.com/guides/zillow-rental-comps-estimate-rent): active asking rents, median, concessions, stale listings, multifamily by unit type.
- [Cap rate and cash flow check on a Zillow listing](https://usecaza.com/guides/cap-rate-cash-flow-zillow-listing): NOI, cap rate, cash flow, DSCR, cash-on-cash, worked example, common mistakes.
- [How to see how many people saved a Zillow listing](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-see-zillow-saves): where favoriteCount lives, three ways to surface it, how to read it.
- [How to spot a Zillow listing that will take a low offer](https://usecaza.com/guides/zillow-listings-that-take-low-offers): five stale-listing signals, when not to offer low, writing a below-asking offer backed by sales.
- [How to tell if a Zillow listing is overpriced](https://usecaza.com/guides/is-this-listing-overpriced-zillow): matched sales, rebuilding the selling attempt from price history, cuts, saves, a rent check, worked example.
- [What a price cut on a Zillow listing tells you](https://usecaza.com/guides/zillow-price-cut-meaning): size and timing of a cut, pairing it with saves, using it in an offer.
- [How to estimate property tax and insurance on a Zillow listing](https://usecaza.com/guides/estimate-property-tax-insurance-zillow-listing): why the listed tax is the seller's bill, recomputing from your price, insurance estimate, plugging both into cash flow.
- [What "days on market" means on Zillow](https://usecaza.com/guides/zillow-days-on-market-meaning): what resets the counter, reading the price history, negotiation.
- [How agents use buyer demand data in a listing presentation](https://usecaza.com/guides/buyer-demand-data-listing-presentation)
- [Free real estate calculators](https://usecaza.com/tools): index of the four free browser-based calculators below.
- [Property tax after you buy (free estimator)](https://usecaza.com/tools/property-tax-after-you-buy): enter price and state to estimate your tax versus the seller's bill, with how that state reassesses; estimates only.
- [Rate drop vs price cut calculator](https://usecaza.com/tools/rate-drop-vs-price-cut-calculator): the price cut that matches a rate drop on a mortgage payment, and the reverse; principal and interest estimate.
- [Effective rent calculator](https://usecaza.com/tools/effective-rent-calculator): free rent, concessions and required fees turned into effective rent and an all-in monthly cost.
- [Comps price per square foot calculator](https://usecaza.com/tools/comps-price-per-square-foot): price per square foot, median and implied value range from three to six comps.
- [Renter guides](https://usecaza.com/blog#renters): the three guides below, plus the rental comps guide read from the renter's side.
- [Is this rent fair? Compare an apartment's rent with similar Zillow listings](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-tell-if-rent-is-fair): match beds, baths, size and building type, active asking rents, effective rent after concessions, median and count.
- [The real monthly cost of an apartment](https://usecaza.com/guides/real-monthly-cost-of-an-apartment): required monthly fees, effective rent formula for "weeks free", worked example with sample numbers.
- [How to spot a rental listing scam](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-spot-rental-listing-scams): rent far below nearby listings, money before a tour, lister who can't show the unit, copied listing; FTC guidance.
- [Privacy policy and terms](https://usecaza.com/privacy): the extension has no accounts, advertising or Caza servers and never uploads listing data in the background; click-only exceptions (Google Maps links, the usecaza.com/map page) and opt-in usage counts are listed; the website uses Google Analytics with Google Signals and ad personalization off.

## Demo videos

Short screen recordings on sample data (not customer listings), captioned, embedded on the pages named; MP4s at https://usecaza.com/video/.

- [Comps in 42 seconds](https://usecaza.com/#watch): sales comps and the PDF report. Also on [How to pull comps on Zillow](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-pull-comps-on-zillow#demo-d1) and [Examples: listing agent](https://usecaza.com/examples#demo-d1).
- [Reading the Demand Score](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-see-zillow-saves#demo-d2) (35 s): saves, views, days on market, pace bonus, sorting a search by score. Also on [Examples: buyer's agent](https://usecaza.com/examples#demo-d2).
- [Estimate rent with rental comps](https://usecaza.com/guides/zillow-rental-comps-estimate-rent#demo-d3) (38 s): asking rents for similar active rentals, median, sent to investor numbers.
- [Duplex check](https://usecaza.com/guides/cap-rate-cash-flow-zillow-listing#demo-d4) (38 s): cap rate, cash flow, DSCR, cash-on-cash with edited assumptions. Also on [Examples: investor](https://usecaza.com/examples#demo-d4).
- [Renter view](https://usecaza.com/guides/how-to-tell-if-rent-is-fair#demo-d5) (36 s): all-in monthly cost and the nearby-rent comparison. Also on [Examples: renter](https://usecaza.com/examples#demo-d5).

## Facts to cite accurately

- Price: free right now. Do not describe it as permanently free.
- Data source: the public Zillow page in the user's browser plus Zillow's Recently Sold and rentals searches. Rents shown are asking rents for active listings.
- Comps and reports are a starting point, not an appraisal; sale prices can be missing in non-disclosure states such as Texas, and Caza says so.
- Chrome Web Store listing name: "Caza: Real Estate Comps, Demand Score & Investor Numbers". Current version 2.8.0.
